input._comment_max_timepoints: Optional. Use only the first N timepoints (after sorting). Set to null or omit to use all. Useful when late timepoints are unusable.

preprocessing._comment_isotropic_reslice: When enabled=false, lightly resample Z so voxels become isotropic (XY pixel size). Lets raw + segmented + tracks share the same shape for overlay. Defaults to true when preprocessing is skipped, false when full preprocessing runs (because full preprocessing already reslices).
preprocessing._comment_method: Preprocessing method: 'deconvolution' (GPU Richardson-Lucy, uses psf_path) or 'selfnet' (deep-learning Self-Net deblurring / isotropic reconstruction, uses selfnet.model_path). Both produce an isotropic, intensity-normalized stack ready for segmentation.

selfnet._comment: Used only when method='selfnet'. model_path is the trained deblur_net .pkl state-dict. model_path_xz / model_path_yz optionally override the per-view models (default: reuse model_path for both). net_min_v/net_max_v are the intensity range used to normalise the network input.

debug_preprocessing._comment: Cellpose params are inherited from the 'segmentation' section. Override here only if needed.

tracking._comment_ultrack_container: Defaults to /groups/pinheiro/user/andres.gordo/containers_licences/ultrack.sif (see nextflow.config). Set this key only to override.
tracking._comment_ultrack_config_toml: Defaults to the ultrack_config.toml at the repo root. Set this key only to override.
